title: crepis multicaulis subsp. congesta
intro: Crepis multicaulis subsp. congesta, commonly known as lesser hawk's beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Crepis multicaulis subsp. congesta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
